Promote evidence-based decision-making and institutional capacity strengthening. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination Build and maintain strong working relationships with government counterparts, education institutions, school management authorities, donors, and implementing partners. Team Supervision Supervise senior technical personnel and oversee multidisciplinary teams and consultants. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture. Schedule Management – Develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), oversee contractor schedules, integrate all project phases, and ensure alignment with contractual milestones and delivery objectives. 3. Information Governance – Ensure consistency, auditability, and traceability of project data, while developing reporting tools, dashboards, databases, and digital project controls solutions. 11. Integrated Controls Management – Coordinate schedule, cost, risk, and information management across all project packages, interfaces, contractors, utilities, and stakeholder groups. 13. Executive Reporting – Prepare and present project controls reports, executive dashboards, risk and cost forecasts, schedule health assessments, portfolio reports, and Board/Steering Committee papers. Cost forecasting, cost control, and performance monitoring. Delivery of risk management, quantitative risk analysis, and change control processes. Effective document management and information governance. Independent verification of contractor performance and project status. Timely identification and escalation of project threats, opportunities, and emerging risks. Quality of executive reporting and decision-support information. Project controls readiness for commissioning, handover, and project close-out. Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary project controls teams. Advanced proficiency with Primavera P6 and enterprise project controls systems. Preferred Experience Utility-scale renewable energy and infrastructure projects, including: Solar PV Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) High-voltage transmission networks Major infrastructure developments Marine and offshore construction Subsea cable projects Distinctive Advantages Project controls leadership on projects valued at US$1 billion+. Experience working with Chinese EPC contractors, manufacturers, and suppliers. Experience delivering projects in Indonesia, Singapore, or other cross-border environments. Experience on large-scale energy, transmission, or interconnector developments. Experience supporting project-financed, lender-funded, or PPP developments. Advanced expertise in quantitative schedule and cost risk analysis, including Monte Carlo simulation and scenario modelling. review_candidates.description: About emoni At emoni , we connect traditional financial services with modern payment and digital asset solutions. Established in 2023 and originally operating under the iLedgends brand, we provide payment accounts, virtual IBANs, SWIFT and SEPA transfers, and digital asset services to businesses and individuals. Our international group operates across the Netherlands, Cyprus, and Canada, combining regulated financial services with extensive experience in payments, cross-border transactions and digital assets. Through our European Electronic Money Institution and Canadian Money Services Business, we deliver secure, compliant and efficient financial solutions in multiple currencies. At emoni, we value collaboration, accountability, innovation and exceptional customer service. We are looking for talented professionals who want to grow with an ambitious international fintech company and contribute directly to its continued success. Job Title: Manager Operations & Service Delivery Department: Operations / First Line of Defense (1LoD) Reports to: Chief Operating Officer (COO) / Board of Directors Location: [Amsterdam / Hybrid] Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours)  Job Description As the Manager Operations & Service Delivery within our e-money licensed financial institution, you are the operational backbone and the First Line of Defense (1LoD) of the organization. You will lead a versatile team responsible for the entire operational lifecycle of our clients: from initial commercial onboarding support and merchant acceptance to daily transaction monitoring, incident management, and regular customer service.  Your primary goal is to ensure smooth, secure, and client-friendly service delivery. You will constantly balance strict compliance and risk management (when onboarding merchants and monitoring transactions) with a proactive, service-oriented mindset (when supporting Sales and assisting existing clients). You ensure that operational excellence and top-tier service go hand in hand.  Key Responsibilities 1. First Line of Defense & Risk Management (1LoD) Act as the owner of operational risks within the department and ensure all processes comply with applicable e-money laws and regulations (such as Wwft/AML and sanctions regulations).  Translate compliance and risk policies (defined by the 2nd line) into concrete, workable operational procedures.  Proactively identify and mitigate risks within the daily client and transaction chain.  2. Onboarding Merchants & Sales Support Hold ultimate responsibility for a smooth and compliant Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Know Your Business (KYB) process for new and existing merchants.  Provide direct support to the Sales team ( Sales Support ) by reviewing the feasibility and risks of potential new clients at an early stage (pre-screening).  Act as the escalation point for complex client files, carefully weighing commercial interests against the established risk appetite.  Continuously optimize the onboarding funnel to shorten the 'time-to-board' for Sales without compromising the quality of the gatekeeper function.  3. Customer Support & Incident Management Directly manage and professionalize the Customer Support function to handle daily functional and operational questions from merchants.  Drive client satisfaction (CSAT), response times (SLAs), and first-contact resolution capabilities.  Hold ultimate responsibility for monitoring the operational IT and payment infrastructure (incident monitoring) to minimize downtime for clients.  Take charge during major operational incidents (Major Incidents), including communication with affected clients and partners.  4. Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Management Oversee daily post-transaction monitoring to detect unusual patterns, fraud, money laundering, and terrorist financing in a timely manner.  Ensure efficient handling of alerts and correct escalation of suspicious transactions (SAR/STR) to the compliance department.  Optimize monitoring systems to reduce 'false positives', ensuring legitimate clients experience no unnecessary friction.  5. Team Leadership & Organization Directly lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team (onboarding analysts, transaction monitors, and support agents).  Build a culture where risk awareness (risk culture) and extreme client focus reinforce each other.  Report operational KPIs (such as turnaround times, support tickets, and SLAs) and KRIs (Key Risk Indicators) to the board. Regulations: Familiar with AML/CFT directives, PSD2/PSD3, and guidelines from financial regulators (such as DNB / AFM).  Skills: Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English. Ability to easily switch between strictly enforcing rules and thinking service-mindedly alongside Sales and clients.  Personality: An empathetic leader, highly analytical, stress-resistant, and commercially sensitive without losing sight of risk boundaries.  What We Offer A unique and broad management role where you are truly the operational engine of the company.  Ample room to further optimize and automate support and onboarding processes from the ground up.  A competitive salary with excellent secondary benefits.
